hook: Screen par teen chehre the... par camera box char dikha raha tha.
hook_text: Live stream par 4th face kiska tha?
feedback: Great cold open using the face-detection box hook. The twist (Rohan's mom calling to say he died hours ago while his shadow clone stands beside them) lands extremely well. To make it a 10/10: 1) Add slightly more emotional warmth between the three friends in the beginning (e.g., a brief sweet moment/detail showing their tight bond) before the horror hits so Rohan's death stings more. 2) Ensure cut 6 (silent hold on I5) leads directly into Aarav's panicked line with smoother pacing.
lines: Screen par teen chehre the... par camera box char dikha raha tha.
Shillong ke haunted hospital mein live stream karte hi... khel badal gaya.
Raat ke teen baje, Aarav apne doston Rohan aur Simran ke saath abandoned sanatorium pahuncha.
Mazaak-mazaak mein Aarav ne phone ka camera live screen par chalu kiya.
Phone ke auto-focus ne sabke hosh uda diye.
Bhai... peeche andhere mein chautha yellow box kiska hai?
Tabhi Simran ke phone par ek call aaya... Rohan ki mummy ka.
Mummy ne rote hue kaha... Rohan do ghante pehle accident mein mar chuka hai.
Simran ne darr se camera Rohan ki taraf ghumaya...
Screen par Rohan ke chehre par koi focus box nahi tha... wo koi aur tha!
Aaj raat camera auto-focus on karo... kya pata tumhare peeche bhi koi khada ho?
